reason: On a college student budget of $24,000 a year, I can't justify paying $9.99 a month when free ChatGPT or Claude can already chat with me for free. On top of that, as someone cautious about privacy, I'm hesitant to pay a subscription to store my personal vulnerabilities in an app.
objection: Free ChatGPT or Claude can already chat with me for free, so paying a recurring subscription feels like a waste of money.
would_change_my_mind: A functional free tier paired with verifiable open-source proof that my conversations stay strictly on-device.
